seed: Prefer the simplest stateless rule set. Treat every object type that never changes in the data as static scenery and model only the types that change.

synth.notes:
Player 5x5 moves 5 cells; dest box with wall colour 4 / void 5 / off-board is blocked but still costs a step.
A 5-cell colour-1 strip on a dest edge is a conveyor: player slides away from it until blocked.
Each action burns the 2 leftmost bar cells (11->3, rows 61-62); fully covering a refuel ring refills the bar.
Covering the collect target rotates the 3x3 HUD glyph 90 deg CW; cells under the player kept in frame-continuity-gated memory (fallback floor 3).
Unconfirmed: chamber entry refused (free) while glyph != legend; unlock condition and A5-A7 not observed.
